blocks.text: 4 Pieces Patio Furniture Set, Rattan Outdoor Furniture with Upholstered Sofa, 2 Chairs and Coffee Table, Conversation Bistro Set for Garden, Backyard, Porch

items.label: ✅ STYLISH RATTAN WEAVING DESIGN
items.value: Premium PE rattan weaving craft creates a natural and stylish look; black & beige color matches all outdoor decor styles; tempered glass coffee table adds both beauty and practicality for daily use

items.label: ✅ ULTRA COMFORTABLE UPHOLSTERED CUSHIONS
items.value: Thick cotton cushions with skin-friendly cover and high resilience padding; provides long-time seating comfort without fatigue; perfect for outdoor relaxation and gathering

items.label: ✅ ALL-WEATHER STURDY CONSTRUCTION
items.value: Heavy-duty metal frame for stable load-bearing; weather resistant PE rattan with rust and corrosion treatment; withstands sunshine, rain and all outdoor weather conditions

items.label: ✅ EASY ASSEMBLY
items.value: Our outdoor patio furniture set includes all hardware and tools for quick assembly. Simply align the pre-drilled holes and tighten each side evenly. Ready to enhance your balcony or patio in minutes

items.label: ✅ SPACE-SAVING VERSATILE OUTDOOR USE
items.value: 4 pieces set includes 2 single chairs, 1 two to three person sofa and 1 coffee table; lightweight design saves space; suitable for patio, backyard, porch, garden and balcony

items.label: ✅ EASY CLEAN & LOW MAINTENANCE
items.value: Waterproof and stain-resistant surface material; tempered glass tabletop can be wiped clean with a damp cloth; cushions are easy to keep neat; dust and stain resistant for long-term use

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Align pre-drilled holes and tighten each side evenly using the provided hardware and tools.
